name: VCRED

listingStatusReview.reason: Owner-approved scope delisting: no substantiated stable-value claim or collateral/reserve evidence; owner minting only. No admissible price since 2026-09-07: CoinGecko stale, no tickers; only material pool ~$16k, below $50k floor. Not a death finding.

oneLiner: VCRED's Hemi source declares a USD peg, but backing and redemption are unverified; its linked website describes an AI/perp-vault access product.
collateral: Unverified for the exact Hemi token. Neither the verified token source nor the linked product site establishes reserve assets, a credit portfolio, or a token-holder claim on the advertised AI/perp vaults.
pegMechanism: The verified source declares a U.S. dollar peg but implements only owner-controlled minting and standard ERC-20 holder/allowance burns. Burns do not pay collateral or dollars, and no exact-token redemption terms or peg-maintenance mechanism were established.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: At Hemi block 5426142, the tracked contract's runtime bytecode exactly matched the explorer's fully verified VCRED source; the explorer reports no proxy or implementation. Its notice expressly declares a stablecoin pegged to the US Dollar. The constructor mints one billion six-decimal units to the owner, mint(address,uint256) is unrestricted onlyOwner issuance, and inherited burn/burnFrom destroy tokens without any payout. There is no collateral, NAV, oracle or redemption implementation. The linked vcred.trade site instead advertises AI/perp market-making vaults and staking VCRED for portfolio access, without binding that product to the exact Hemi address or publishing token-specific mint/redeem terms. Withdraw the unsupported rwa-credit-fund archetype and prior collateral/custody claims; retain the declared USD target, existing non-core listing class and lifecycle pending a binding issuer identity and economic-mechanism disclosure. Neither a replacement archetype nor a definitive non-stablecoin finding is supported by the inspected primary evidence.

sources.label: Fully verified exact Hemi VCRED source and runtime bytecode

notices.title: Identity and stablecoin mechanism unresolved
notices.message: The 2026-10-02 exact-token review found a declared USD peg but no redemption payout or collateral mechanism, while the linked website described portfolio access without an exact-contract identity join. On 2026-10-22, the owner approved scope delisting because a substantiated stable-value holder claim and collateral/reserve evidence remained unestablished. The profile and prior research are retained read-only; this is not a cemetery or death entry.
